model.newStaticEvidenceRoute: For static review only, a fully explicit synthetic institution snapshot and history may demonstrate the same algorithm. It does not satisfy a claim of canonical faction history or resolve KR326-C01. This is an express new scoped decision replacing the old no-synthetic-authorization statement solely for this fixture.
model.admission: Name one exact distinguishable institution ID already known to the caster; choose one willing perceived recipient within 120 ft and LoE. No nearby member, positive reputation, membership or rank-7 feed prerequisite. Unknown/nonexistent institution resolves after payment to the same neutral No information available result as inaccessible evidence.

inputSchema.institution: stable ID, aliases with effective dates, predecessor/successor links with evidence, observation timestamp
inputSchema.fact: stable fact ID, institutional subject/relation, fact/report/belief classification, value, validAt/recordedAt, source ID/version, disclosure audience, plane-access permission, protection operand
inputSchema.forecastInput: versioned plans, constraints and tendencies actually known at observation; no seeded future state as proof

model.query: Produce the complete permitted institutional record at observation, including remote same-plane branches and history. Do not replace the dossier with one sample. A missing record is unknown, not affirmative absence. Separate independently accessible institutional records from any protected personal fact they might otherwise corroborate.
model.privacy: Output only permitted facts and their actual record provenance. Never expose hidden roster size, omitted count, hidden index gaps, protective diagnosis or a protected person's current truth through an institutional relabeling. A direct unavailable query returns No information available without cause. Public report text remains labeled report rather than validated personal truth.
model.prediction: Horizon is [observation,observation+604800000 ms]. Every supported likely development is included with evidence IDs, assumptions, alternatives and qualitative uncertainty. Deterministic given the same versioned inputs. No numeric probability unless an independently bound model supplies it; no compulsion of future actors.
model.memoryAndRetrieval: Resolution grants the timestamped permitted dossier to the selected recipient only. It is ordinary acquired memory thereafter. Focused tactical retrieval costs one Action, or 6000 ms of focused work outside initiative; ordinary recognition/communication uses shared rules. No ongoing source, refresh, remote live feed or dispel erasure.
